basis: Uploaded ZIP; no claim that live main or all historical runs were verified.

closed_previous_items.item: Canonical API import and value-carrying writer/loader/builder chain
Generalized scorer uses A_policy=A_LR and A_ref=A_RR; incomplete RR rejected
All seven tested serializers retain 1e-12 masses and canonical targets
Pool digests recompute text hashes; explicit row verifier rejects stale cached SHA in all five current panel helpers
UW1 label and generator anchor corrected
Word/token asymmetry, fit convergence status and two-order inclusion tests continue to pass

issues.title: Standalone local gate exists, but authoritative campaign orchestration still does not invoke it
issues.observed: Actual cached-logprob gate CLI computes per-prompt values, accepts positive fixtures, rejects all-negative/NaN/Inf fixtures, and changes filesystem records. Existing campaign job generators and trainer save path are byte-identical; only the separate selftest calls the gate in inspected current source.
required_changes: Add a single prompt-wise stage controller that invokes trainer, computes/verifies monitoring artifacts, calls the gate, and supplies the returned accepted/parent policy to the next stage and evaluator.
Keep Global Nash's aggregate evaluator separate.
Retain honest ungated labels for historical experiments; adding a gate does not retroactively gate old checkpoints.
acceptance_tests: Tiny synthetic campaign with stubbed expensive trainer/forward only: candidate passes -> next stage uses candidate; candidate fails or missing decision -> next stage uses parent; no direct candidate evaluation after rejection.
Record actual resolved module paths and hashes to exclude hidden /work overlays.

issues.title: Gate default coverage and surplus threshold differ from the supplied manuscript
issues.observed: Default coverage_min=.5 promotes 2-positive/2-negative development prompts. Even coverage_min=1 accepts all local surpluses near 5e-9. The supplied Appendix H Selection and reporting contract requires every retained local surplus >1e-8.
required_changes: Use every local surplus > declared surplus_tol=1e-8 for the paper-matching profile; coverage is a diagnostic, not a replacement for the all-prompt predicate.
A relaxed 50% coverage variant must be explicit and cannot silently represent the paper profile.
acceptance_tests: Mixed +s/-s array rejected under defaults; all >1e-8 accepted; any <=1e-8 rejected; thresholds validated before execution.

issues.title: Missing requested nMSE and negative infinity can promote a candidate
issues.observed: Passing --nmse-from with an empty log_history yields fit=null and accepted=true. nMSE=-Infinity yields fit=true and a promotion. nMSE=1.2, NaN and +Infinity are correctly rejected.
required_changes: Require the fit result in paper mode; missing requested field must not be treated as pass.
Require finite nMSE with 0<=nMSE<=nmse_max.

Prefer recomputing the declared pair-weighted nMSE from already cached logprob differences and canonical g, with explicit handling of zero denominator; otherwise bind trainer state to exact candidate, evaluation step, split and target hash.
Intentional no-fit diagnostics must be non-promoting or explicitly labeled as a different acceptance contract.
acceptance_tests: Empty log_history, absent metric, null, negative, NaN, positive/negative Inf cannot promote; valid finite <=1 passes.

issues.title: Gate decisions are not bound to the solved game and actual checkpoint
issues.observed: A certified beta=.05 target is accepted using default beta=.25 (+.034672 local surplus), while matching beta=.05 rejects it (-.146221). Corrupting target g without updating the solution manifest is not rejected. Cached logprobs plus a nonexistent candidate path can create an ACCEPTED record with SHA256(empty).
required_changes: Load and verify per-prompt target manifest, target SHA, score tensor hashes, beta, proposal center/reference, prompt IDs and fixed monitoring subset before evaluation.
Infer beta/shard metadata from the verified run; reject incompatible explicit overrides.
Bind cached logprobs and trainer state to candidate, parent, token-event/pool, target and evaluator hashes.
Require existing checkpoint and actual supported weight/config files before promotion; missing files are a failure, not an empty fingerprint.
Treat accepted-directory metadata as a pointer explicitly; the stage controller must resolve it before model loading.
acceptance_tests: Wrong beta, modified target, changed score bank, wrong parent, missing candidate weights and mismatched cache manifests all fail closed without promotion.

issues.title: Correct alias checks added, but valid equal-valued tensors are rejected and missing semantics bypass checks
issues.observed: All five loaders reject actual correctly scored A_LL=A_LR=A_RR despite distinct declared bank roles and a certified positive Nash solution (minimum surplus .140463 for K=2 and .169478 for K=4). If semantic arrays are removed, the all(...) guard skips alias checking and can load a mislabeled v2 shard.
required_changes: Require all v2 semantic arrays and role fields before loading.
Keep A_policy==A_LR and A_ref==A_RR validation; remove the A_policy!=A_LL requirement. Semantic roles cannot be inferred from accidental numerical inequality.
Validate finite values, complete shapes, objective/prompt cardinalities and bank mappings.
Regenerate all five panel helpers from the corrected source; test the generation itself.
acceptance_tests: Valid equal arrays accepted, malformed aliases rejected, missing A_LR/A_RR rejected, wrong bank roles rejected; no data-dependent exclusion based on equality alone.

issues.title: New gate needs a pod-specific helper import and hardcodes four score shards
issues.observed: With repo root and current snapshot on PYTHONPATH, --help fails on diag_neural_pools. Adding the included historical helper directory resolves import and all numeric CLI tests used that real helper. The gate calls load_scores(args.scores,4); the supplied selftest hardcodes private /work data and only prints its failure list.
required_changes: Use a package-relative shared helper and document one clean-checkout launch command.
Expose or infer validated shard count, not literal 4.
Add portable synthetic regressions to tests/; selftest must exit nonzero when a recorded assertion fails.
acceptance_tests: Clean checkout --help and cached CLI work without /work overlay; non-4 shard fixtures are covered; selftest has meaningful process exit status.

non_claims: No actual run is alleged to contain the deliberately malformed fixtures.
No LLM weights were loaded or trained, and no benchmark scores were recomputed.
Test counts are not counts of independent defects; several cases repeat a guard across panel modules.
